title: Local pullback adjunction induces an isomorphism on the original stalk
statement: Let Y be a scheme, y a point, A=O_{Y,y}, and c:Spec(A)→Y its canonical morphism. For any O_Y-module G, any O_{Spec(A)}-module H, and any isomorphism beta:c*G→H, the adjoint G→c_*H induces an isomorphism of A-modules on stalks at y. [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]

source.place: Tensor pullback stalk formula, combined with Tag 01J7 and the canonical local-spectrum morphism; the unit germ calculation in the parent node step 1.

proof.text: At the closed point z, the canonical pullback-unit germ comparison is an isomorphism. The direct-image stalk comparison q is invertible because c is a topological embedding (Mathlib Scheme.Hom.isEmbedding for the canonical flat monomorphism and TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward.stalkPushforward_iso_of_isInducing). On every germ the composite of the stalk unit with q is the specified module-stalk isomorphism. Equality on germs gives equality of maps; cancel q to get invertibility of the stalk unit.

The adjoint of beta is the unit followed by c_*beta (Adjunction.homEquiv_unit). Pushforward, passage to presheaves and stalks preserve isomorphisms. Compose and use c(z)=y to obtain the claimed module-stalk isomorphism.

theorem localPullback_adjoint_stalk_isIso (Y : Scheme.{u}) (y : Y)
    (G : Y.Modules) (H : (Spec (Y.presheaf.stalk y)).Modules)
    (beta : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (Y.fromSpecStalk y)).obj G ⟶ H)
    [IsIso beta] :
    IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).map
      ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
        (Y.fromSpecStalk y))).homEquiv _ _ beta))
